verdict: Leads dropped 40% this week; cost per lead rose while infrastructure gaps persist.
narrative: This period you received 91 leads at a cost per lead of $20.49 — but the most recent week saw leads fall 40% and cost per lead climb 51% compared to the week prior, a confirmed downtrend across the last several days. Google Business Profile engagement also dropped sharply this week (down 48%), which had been supporting lead volume through organic-assisted conversions; that assist has effectively stopped. Separately, 10 build milestones dating back to July remain unresolved — landing pages, tracking, and full campaign infrastructure are not yet live, which limits what the current ad spend can do. We are moving to clear those blockers in priority order, starting with tracking and profile optimisation at the Weston and Dr Phillips locations, where call rates are significantly below the other locations. Expect lead volume to remain pressured until infrastructure is in place; once it is, the current spend level has more room to perform.
